body: U+0023 2026-10-08: first ship attempt failed, re-proof, retryU+000AU+000AThe first `SHIP=1 run.zsh --resume` exited 22. pr.mjs requires --why, --what and --risk values to start with an uppercase letter and end with `. ? !`, and to use ASCII only. The windows-desktop risk began with "macOS", the runner's "what" and "more" began lowercase, and the pipeline's "what" began with "release.yml". I fixed all of them in pr_adapter.py and validated every field with a script before retrying.U+000AU+000AThe re-run gate on windows-desktop came back with 35 pass and 8 inconclusive. The cause is the lead commit to lib/features/garden/widgets/garden_view.dart (7b32c350), which sits outside every Step's write-set. The gate therefore did not revert it, but it did delete the new windows_caption_buttons.dart that garden_view imports. Every test that transitively imports the app then fails to compile in garden_view, and accept.zsh exits 2 (not run).U+000AU+000AI re-proved the 8 tests in the scratchpad (`git archive` of 89f7a06f). With all 51 implementation paths plus garden_view.dart reverted to 65bbbe27, each of the 8 exits 1 under accept.zsh, and each passes in the suite with the work in place. The windows-desktop PR body records this in a --verified line.U+000AU+000ALesson for future runs: a lead commit to a file outside the write-sets makes the gate inconclusive for every test that imports that file. Declare the file in a Step before the run, or fold the change into a declared file.
